tweet.text:
Run crap and mutate to get those functions smaller and less coupled.  Write acceptance tests (in gherkin) that you manage but the AI must make pass.  Run a scrap analyzer to keep your test code under control.   Run a dependency checker to keep your architecture under control.  

Build walls around the AI using hard tools.  Don't let the AI escape from those tools.  

The price of productivity is continual vigilance.
